DECLARE V_CNT NUMBER; BEGIN SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT FROM ICOMCDDT WHERE CODE = $V_CODE$ AND CODE_NO = 'H024' AND HOUSE_CODE = '100' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KEPC' AND USE_FLAG = '1';
IF V_CNT = 0 THEN INSERT INTO ICOMCDDT ( HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , CODE_NO , CODE , STATUS , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , TEXT1 , SORT_SEQ , USE_FLAG ) VALUES ( '100' , 'KEPC' , 'H024' , $V_CODE$ , 'C' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , 'DBA' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , 'DBA' , $V_TEXT$ , $V_SEQ$ , '1' ); ELSE UPDATE ICOMCDDT SET TEXT1 = $V_TEXT$, SORT_SEQ = $V_SEQ$, CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE CODE = $V_CODE$ AND CODE_NO = 'H024' AND HOUSE_CODE = '100' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KEPC' AND USE_FLAG = '1'; END IF; END;
